competency_fulfillment.rationale: The bare verb is met and the arithmetic is sound: seed 44 'What is 204 + 270?' -> 474, seed 46 'What is 401 + 418?' -> 819, seed 502 'What is 902 + 92?' -> 994, and seed 42 correctly flags 'Manny solved: "505 + 111 = ___". Manny says the missing number is 626' as an error with correct_value 616. What is not met is the qualifying clause 'with or without regrouping' -- only the 'without' half is ever tested. One item is also not really addition of two numbers: seed 61 is a counting-on task whose stem hands the pupil the strategy.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Not one of the 18 items requires regrouping. Every pair is carry-free in every column: 505+111 (42), 740+15 (43), 204+270 (44), 540+10 (45), 401+418 (46), 600+170 (47), 990+8 (48), 952+46 (52), 60+8 (61), 912+24 (500), 510+472 (501), 902+92 (502), 457+121 (600), 510+30 (601), 501+150 (602), 240+750 (603), 702+204 (604), 960+30 (605). The avoidance looks systematic rather than accidental: the items that push toward the ceiling are built as '240 + 750' (990), '960 + 30' (990) and '952 + 46' (998) -- each deliberately arranged so no column reaches ten. Half the competency's stated scope, and the harder half that a sums-to-1000 competency exists to teach, is never exercised at all.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Grade 2, Quarter 1. Two items sit below the level: seed 61 is Grade-1 counting-on with the method pre-supplied, and seed 45 'What is 540 + 10?' is a single tens-place bump. Seed 52 'Show 952 + 46 on the number line.' also mismatches its own instruction: the pupil is told to SHOW something on a number line, but the expected response is the single value 998. The remaining items are pitched correctly -- seed 502 and seed 601 'Moses is on step 510. Moses climbs up 30 more steps.' are both age-appropriate.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Seven distinct formatters appear and they make genuinely different demands: error_detect (42), read_fill_in_blank (43), mcq (46), cloze (47), true_false (48), set_fill_in_blank (52, number line) and read_mcq (61), plus one genuine word-problem context at seed 601. Item shape is therefore varied. The numeric monotony underneath it -- every addend pair regroup-free -- is a real defect but is scored under comprehensive_coverage rather than double-counted here.

competency_alignment.rationale: Nothing exceeds the competency. Only two-addend whole-number addition appears: no subtraction, no multiplication, no missing-addend algebra, no expanded-form or place-value naming. No answer breaches the stated ceiling -- the largest are 998 (52), 994 (502), and 990 (603, 605) -- and where 1000 appears it is only as a wrong option, correctly marked is_correct false.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The upper bound is respected exactly: nothing exceeds 1000, and the near-boundary items are legitimate (998 at seed 52; 994 at seed 502). The floor is the problem. Seed 61 works on 60 + 8 = 68 with a single-digit addend, and seed 45 'What is 540 + 10?' adds a bare ten -- both sit far below the magnitude a 'sums up to 1000' competency describes, and seed 61 in particular is a one-digit counting exercise embedded in a three-digit competency.
